scope: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium, standard 2–4-player multiplayer, including mandatory two-player House Hagal. Solo, variants, expansions, promos and Uprising excluded.
verdict_explanation: The extracted procedural text and applicable base FAQ rules are covered, and no material error was confirmed in the 72 existing answer keys. However, the illustrated Duke Leto Atreides card on main PDF p6 states two consequential ability restrictions not required by any existing question. One combined question is proposed. A small House Hagal card illustration also has a legibility limitation recorded below, so this review does not certify absolute saturation of unreadable raster card text.

independence.note: The permitted coverage ledger necessarily contains previous acceptance/rejection metadata; it was compared as instructed. No linked prior report was opened.

findings.title: Illustrated Leto cost modifier and relative-Influence requirement are not tested
findings.detail: Main PDF p6 embeds Duke Leto Atreides. Landsraad Popularity reduces the Solari cost of sending an Agent to a Landsraad-icon board space by one. Prudent Diplomacy costs one spice and gains one Influence with a Faction where an opponent has more Influence than Leto. Q23 covers general left/right Leader timing and card priority; Q04/Q05 cover ordinary entry costs; Q33 covers fixed Influence/Alliance icon requirements. None requires these distinct printed restrictions. The p6 coverage-map entry therefore does not establish coverage of all material illustrated card text.

source_references.passage: Illustrated Duke Leto Atreides Leader; native image xref521, 288×202. Both ability texts visually inspected in the page render and native image.

findings.title: House Hagal Harvest Spice target-selection inset cannot support a fully fixed answer at supplied resolution
findings.detail: Main PDF p19 says to follow the instructions on a Harvest Spice card. Its pictured card is a native149×107 raster (xref1077). The location-selection instruction is too blurred to transcribe with adequate confidence even after high-magnification rendering. Q19 tests removal of bonus spice and generic card-following but does not explicitly request this pictured target-selection procedure. No addition or fixed selection/tiebreak answer is proposed from unreadable fragments; this is an unresolved source-evidence limitation, not a confirmed omission.

source_references.passage: Harvest Spice cards inset and native image xref1077.

proposed_questions.question: For Duke Leto Atreides, which board-space category does Landsraad Popularity discount, by how much, and does that change the cost paid to enter the space? What cost and relative-Influence condition apply to Prudent Diplomacy; may it target a Faction where no opponent has more Influence than Leto?
proposed_questions.fixed_answer: Landsraad Popularity reduces the Solari entry cost of a Landsraad-icon (green) board space by 1 when Leto sends an Agent there; apply that reduction to the entry cost before resolving the space or played card. It is not a discount on spaces with other Agent icons. When Leto activates Prudent Diplomacy with Signet Ring, he may pay 1 spice to gain 1 Influence with a Faction where at least one opponent has more Influence than he does. A Faction where no opponent is ahead is ineligible; a tie alone is insufficient.

source_references.passage: Duke Leto illustration: Landsraad Popularity and Prudent Diplomacy.
Board Space Costs: pay cost before resolving card/space effects; arrow costs and effects.

proposed_questions.novelty: This tests a printed modifier to otherwise mandatory Agent-entry cost and a relative-opponent eligibility condition for gaining Influence. These are distinct rule restrictions, not new card statistics substituted into already-tested arithmetic, and they are not obtained by mechanically recombining existing effects. Q23 supplies only generic Leader timing, while Q04/Q05 do not ask how an entry-cost modifier operates. Q33 asks absolute numeric Influence/Alliance prerequisites, not whether an opponent must be strictly ahead.
proposed_questions.recommended_integration: Add as one combined named-Leader question or add its two explicit clauses to Q23; do not count the repeated timing context as additional novelty.
